source: WhatsApp Image 2026-10-25 at 18.25.56 (5).jpeg, profile a360 (540x1170 device / 1.5 = 360x780 CSS), transcribed with scripts/qa/pxprobe.mjs row|col|at|box|bbox and re-read with the IDENTICAL call on qa/out/07-login-ar-dark-filled.png. Origin: every capture paints the first 25 CSS px with the page background (#f5f6f8 light / #101115 dark) and starts the green band at 25, while a headless render resolves env(safe-area-inset-top) to 0px — so the page floors that reserve at max(25px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) and DOM y and capture y then share one origin.

components.note: col 20 0 60 on 18.25.55 paints page bg #f5f6f8 to 24.5 then brand (dark 18.25.56 (2): #101115 to 25) -> the web view starts BELOW a 25 CSS status strip, so the render floors that inset at 25px. Flat bottom edge 137->139 at x=35 and x=325; at x=10 it curls to 133.5, which solves for r=25 (r=27 would read 131.5). at 20 40 = #009577; box 12,60 20x20 in dark = 400 px of one colour #1bb495. radius 0 is the TOP-left corner (measure.mjs reads borderTopLeftRadius); the 25 is on the bottom corners and is asserted by the arc reading above.

row 120: band->card at 42.75, card->band at 316.25 (w 273.5, cx 179.5). col 60: green to 72.75, card 73..234.5 (h 162). row 76 (dy 3.25) inset 7.75 and row 80 (dy 7.25) inset 3.5 both solve r=16. It lies ON the band: 65 CSS of the card is over green and 96.75 hangs below the band edge — the header+card pair is what the user meant by the header not being the same.

bbox 30 245 330 300 (BG=page bg, MIN=60) -> ink x 110.5..247.5 (w 137) y 269..284.5 (h 15.5), cx 179. The DOM box y is that ink top minus the half-leading of 21.5px in a 26px line box, verified by running the identical bbox call on qa/out/01-login-en-light.png until the ink landed on 269..284.5. Height matches; the ink width still reads ~14 CSS over because Poppins is ~11 per cent wider than the face in the capture (see qa/requests/login.md).

row 420: page->card 17/18.5, card->page 341/346.5 (x 17.5 w 325); col 30: page to 328.5, card 330..608 (h 280); rows 332/337 corner inset solves r=16. Card->pill gutter is 20 (pill hairline 37, card content 37.5) — the 27.5 an earlier pass transcribed was the pill corner arc at y 420, not its edge.

bbox 30 328 330 378 (BG=card white, MIN=40) -> ink x 42..148 y 356..368 (cap+descender 12 on Registration number); Password gives x 42..91.5 y 450..458.5 (cap 8.5 -> 8.5/0.70 = 12.1). So 12 CSS, weight 500, ink starting 3 CSS inside the pill column.

Edges read at the widest row (row 403, the vertical middle): hairline 37..38.5 and 321..322.5 -> x 37.5 w 285. col 178: top border 379/380.5, bottom 425/426.5 -> y 379.5 h 46.5, so r = h/2 = 23.25 (row 380.5/383/387 arcs fit full-round). Hairline at 37.5 390 samples #a1a3a2 on the white card and #93969d on the dark card; --field-border (#cfd3da/#3a3f4d) is 46/89 off.

bbox 47 385 100 420 (BG=pill fill, MIN=25) -> glyph ink x 52.5..67.5 y 395..409.5 (15 x 14.5), cx 60 cy 402.3 = the pill vertical centre (402.8); a 16 box at px-15 puts the ink at 53.5..69.5 -> 1 CSS off. It does NOT mirror in Arabic: row 403 on (4) reads grey ink 59..64, on (6) green ink 58.5..64.5 — same left side as EN, while the AR value hugs the right edge. Ink colour box 52,394 16x16: darkest frequent #949597 (light) / #95969b (dark); thin 16px strokes at 1.5x cannot resolve the core, so colour tol 12.

bbox 72 388 300 418 (BG=pill fill) on 18.25.56 (1) -> typed 202133010290 ink x 81..187.5 (w 106.5) y 396.5..407.5 (h 11); 12 digits over 106.5 = 8.9 advance = 0.55em = Poppins digits at 16 CSS. The same call on 02-login-en-light-filled.png measures 105 x 11.5. So 16/400, NOT the 13/500 the old class claimed — index.css declares input,textarea,button { font: inherit } OUTSIDE @layer, so a text-[] or font-[] utility on a form control is dead code and the control renders the inherited 16/400. The type now sits on the pill, where it is real.
